NOTICE TO THE JUDGMENT DEBTOR
If this memorandum of costs is filed at the same time as an application for a writ of execution, any statutory costs, not exceeding $100 in
aggregate and not already allowed by the court, may be included in the writ of execution. The fees sought under this memorandum may be
disallowed by the court upon a motion to tax filed by the debtor, notwithstanding the fees having been included in the writ of execution.
(Code Civ. Proc., § 685.070(e).) A motion to tax costs claimed in this memorandum must be filed within 10 days after service of the
memorandum. (Code Civ. Proc., § 685.070(c).)
